SELECT
    rd.bottypeval AS robot_type,
    AVG(mf.faultpredscore) AS avg_sis,
    MAX(mf.faultpredscore) AS max_sis
FROM
    robot_details AS rd
JOIN
    maintenance_and_fault AS mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
WHERE
    mf.faultpredscore IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    rd.bottypeval
ORDER BY
    avg_sis DESC;
